0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000010_THANCRED
0.description: They've almost finished loading our cargo. We should be ready to depart right on schedule, or so I'm told.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000020_YSHTOLA
1.description: Excellent. 'Tis nice to have a smooth beginning to one's journey, at the very least.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000040_THANCRED
3.description: Master Louisoix came here on a ship very much like this one.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000050_THANCRED
4.description: And now, years later, the street urchin he befriended that day is bound for his mentor's homeland. With his mentor's grandchildren, no less.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000060_URIANGER
5.description: Aye, 'tis upon reflection that every twist of time's river and fate's whims are brought into sharp relief.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000070_URIANGER
6.description: Thou hast matured much in the intervening years. Wert thou not caught attempting to relieve Master Louisoix of his purse scant moments after he made landfall upon this dock?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000080_ALISAIE
7.description: Oh really? Now that's a tale I'd like to hear!

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: Will this be your first visit to Sharlayan, Ser Estinien?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000120_ESTINIEN
11.description: Are we strangers newly met? Why this stiff formality?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000130_ALPHINAUD
12.description: I...ah...merely meant it as a professional courtesy, since we are now colleagues in an official sense...

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000140_ESTINIEN
13.description: I'd rather you dispense with the “sers,” especially in private company.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000150_ESTINIEN
14.description: Or I'll be forced to respond in kind. “Little Lord Alphinaud.”

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000160_ALPHINAUD
15.description: You've made your point, Estinien. Painfully well.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000180_GRAHATIA
18.description: Are you all right, Tataru? You seem positively distraught.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000190_TATARU
19.description: Distraught? Me? Don't be silly! I think it's lovely that they get to see their homeland.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000200_TATARU
20.description: It's just...we're trying to thwart the schemes of an army hells-bent on destroying the world.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000210_TATARU
21.description: And once again I have to stay behind and worry that this is the last time I'll get to see my friends...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
23.description: I'll bring them back safe and sound. I promise.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
24.description: No sense worrying about the things we're powerless to change.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000250_ALISAIE
28.description: Hoary! Coultenet! What brings you all this way?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000260_HOARYBOULDER
29.description: We're to assist the Maelstrom and the kobolds with a lunar primal operation, so we thought we'd see you off before heading to the tower.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000270_HOARYBOULDER
30.description: F'lhaminn and the others wish you all a safe journey, and promise that they'll look after things here until you return.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000280_HOARYBOULDER
31.description: We will too, of course! Aye, we your fellow Scions of the Seventh Dawn will do our part to ensure the end of the world won't happen on our watch!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000290_LINERCREW
32.description: We're set to sail! All aboard for Sharlayan!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000310_ALPHINAUD
34.description: Then we must delay no longer. We will contact you the moment we learn aught of value. Wish us luck.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000320_TATARU
35.description: Have a safe journey! And please, <hex:021A020203>please<hex:021A020103> be careful!

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000330_EMETSELCH
36.description: And so you venture forth unto the unknown.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000340_EMETSELCH
37.description: A fate beyond the horizon that cannot be divined. A future undefined and in flux.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000350_EMETSELCH
38.description: In uncertain times, naught but the simplest words of wisdom will suffice.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000360_EMETSELCH
39.description: That which lives is destined to die. Love leads to loss. Every beginning has an end.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000370_EMETSELCH
40.description: Treasure every moment, every step of your descent.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000380_EMETSELCH
41.description: And there in the depths where souls and stars rest─find your truth.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000420_GRAHATIA
45.description: The day has barely dawned, my fellow earlier riser.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000430_GRAHATIA
46.description: Though we're hardly alone in that. Envious of those still sleeping soundly, no doubt.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000440_GRAHATIA
47.description: Called out to you, you say? Hmm. I've heard nothing myself.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000450_GRAHATIA
48.description: In any case, I daresay the sea air will do you good. Why not join the others on deck? Sharlayan should be coming into view at any moment.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000460_HYDAELYN
49.description: (-???-)My voice yet reaches you. I am glad.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000480_HYDAELYN
51.description: And thus do we meet face-to-face at last. My Warrior of Light, guided by the Crystal.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
54.description: I can trust your words no longer.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000490_HYDAELYN
55.description: After your sojourn in the First, I believe you have your answer...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000500_HYDAELYN
56.description: You have visited the First. You...have every right to say that.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000510_HYDAELYN
57.description: You have gained an understanding of what I truly am. What Hydaelyn has always been. A primal.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000520_HYDAELYN
58.description: Zodiark was created to forestall the apocalypse which threatened the ancient world. And I was brought forth to bind Him.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000530_HYDAELYN
59.description: Yet seven times now, those who would orchestrate a return to that bygone era have rejoined a shard to the god I had sundered.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000540_HYDAELYN
60.description: The greater His strength grows, the swifter does mine own diminish. The power to draw your mind into the rift betwixt is no longer mine to wield.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000550_HYDAELYN
61.description: Yet though it taxes me sorely, I dare not leave these words unsaid.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000560_HYDAELYN
62.description: Even bereft of my guidance, you and your companions have accepted the burden of this star's troubled past. A conjunction has begun to form; an intertwining of your time and mine.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000570_HYDAELYN
63.description: Wheels shudder and turn. Conflict looms─monumental─which will decide the fate of this world and all life upon it.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000580_HYDAELYN
64.description: When you truly understand what is at stake, and your journey has prepared you to surmount the insurmountable...

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000590_HYDAELYN
65.description: Then shall I honor the promise made in another time. Another age.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000600_LINERCREW
66.description: Cast yer peepers to the fore, folks! Sharlayan's just over yonder!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000610_HYDAELYN
67.description: I will not keep you further. Your traveler's heart must yearn to behold this unfamiliar land.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000640_ALISAIE
70.description: What a fine morning. Oof. Still a bit stiff, though.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000650_ALPHINAUD
71.description: And a good morning to you, too. Taken a look at the island already?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000660_ALISAIE
72.description: Then let's go, let's go! Might still be room in the prow if we're lucky.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000680_THANCRED
74.description: There she is. Good ol' Sharlayan.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000700_ALISAIE
76.description: Home. Home at last. Well...maybe not in Father's eyes...but we'll manage on our own, if we must.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000710_ESTINIEN
77.description: You do know you're not alone in this, don't you?

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000720_URIANGER
78.description: Indeed, 'tis as Ser Estinien sayeth. Forget not the comrades who boarded this ship at your side, I prithee.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000730_ALPHINAUD
79.description: Thank you, my friends. We are ever grateful for your steadfast support.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000740_YSHTOLA
80.description: Upon arrival, we will be disembarking into the heart of Sharlayan proper.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000750_YSHTOLA
81.description: There is no greater concentration of wisdom in all the world. I am confident that, somewhere within that center of knowledge and learning, we will find the answers we seek.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000760_EMETSELCH
82.description: Sharlayan, the solitary island nation of the northern seas.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000770_EMETSELCH
83.description: Where under the watchful gaze of Thaliak, patron deity of scholars, academics hoard all manner of knowledge and secrets.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000780_EMETSELCH
84.description: Once, they deigned to accept foreign students into a distant colony maintained in the Dravanian hinterlands.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000790_EMETSELCH
85.description: How swiftly they abandoned it once the first Garlean boot set hostile foot on Ala Mhigan soil.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000800_EMETSELCH
86.description: So averse to the prosecution of war, these men of wisdom. Your would-be allies...

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000810_THANCRED
87.description: I thought they'd never let us off the ship... What's next, then? Entry applications?

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000820_YSHTOLA
88.description: Hopefully they find no cause to deny us.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000830_ESTINIEN
89.description: Hasn't Sharlayan all but severed relations with foreign powers? Those of us without direct ties─myself included─may be refused outright...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000840_YSHTOLA
90.description: 'Tis true that, as a nation, Sharlayan only forms trade agreements with a select few neutral countries.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000850_YSHTOLA
91.description: But from a practical standpoint, an island cannot afford to be overly strict with its borders. Especially not if that island's people are wholly devoted to the accumulation of knowledge.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000860_YSHTOLA
92.description: If one submits the proper paperwork, with satisfactory evidence of identity and intent, then foreigners may be granted entry.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000880_YSHTOLA
94.description: Quite. So let us be absolutely clear on these points before we proceed.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000890_YSHTOLA
95.description: The immigration officer will ask for your affiliation and your purpose of visit. Considering Sharlayan's views on intervention, I strongly suggest we avoid any mention of the Scions.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000900_YSHTOLA
96.description: Krile has laid the groundwork for us to act as associates of the Students of Baldesion, and our ostensible reason for being here is to aid in their order's restoration.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000910_YSHTOLA
97.description: G'raha Tia, it might expedite our progress should an actual Student be seen at the head of our little group. Would you mind leading the way?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000920_GRAHATIA
98.description: Of course. The immigration offices were this way, as I recall. Shall we?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000930_GRAHATIA
99.description: Greetings! We've just arrived, and are eager to make our way into the city. Would you be so kind as to process our entry applications?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000940_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
100.description: Certainly. I see by your mark you are an Archon?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000950_GRAHATIA
101.description: I am. G'raha Tia of the Students of Baldesion, at your service.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000960_GRAHATIA
102.description: I was assigned to an Eorzean survey team, but have returned to assist with the reformation of my order. My associates here will provide additional support.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000970_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
103.description: Very good. I have paperwork detailing your group and its scheduled arrival for today.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_000980_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
104.description: And it seems some few of your companions are also Archons. If you'll step forward, we can process those applications first.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001000_ALISAIE
106.description: See how it glows? That list is aetherically linked with the citizen registry kept in the main repository.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001010_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
107.description: I've confirmed your status as Archons and amended your travel records accordingly. Welcome home.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001020_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
108.description: Now, who do we have here...?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001050_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
111.description: Your applications have also been approved. Having said that...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001060_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
112.description: The streets are abuzz with talk of how House Leveilleur's lord disowned his young progeny.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001070_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
113.description: And while such personal circumstances constitute no reason to deny you entry, I urge you to avoid...exacerbating your present situation. Times are quite troubled enough already.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001080_ALPHINAUD
114.description: We shall keep that in mind.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001090_GRAHATIA
115.description: These last two are not Sharlayan natives, but you will find their credentials are in order. An application was made in advance...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001110_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
121.description: An “adventurer...” Well, I suppose that is considered a valid calling in your native Eorzea, and it does indeed match the profile provided. You may enter.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001120_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
122.description: Indeed... Your profile describes you as an “adventurer,” but one also trained in the rather more constructive pursuits of procurement and production. You may enter.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001130_GRAHATIA
123.description: And it is a title well earned, I can assure you!

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001140_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
124.description: An “adventurer” by trade is what your documentation indicates. No mention of this particular title─self-appointed, I take it? Either way, your employer seems willing to vouch for your character, so I shall─albeit reluctantly─grant you entry. “Champion.”

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001160_ESTINIEN
126.description: Estinien Varlineau. Formerly of the Order of the Knights Dragoon in Ishgard.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001170_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
127.description: “Formerly,” at least. And what, pray tell, is your “profession” now?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001190_KRILE
129.description: My associate is a mercenary, hired for his strength at arms! Surely you are aware of the dangers we often face on our forays into the wilderness?

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001200_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
130.description: Mistress Baldesion. If you insist on sponsoring his entry, then so be it.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001210_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
131.description: But while I appreciate that desperate times call for desperate measures, I find your choice of company concerning. Be advised that even a single misstep may have severe repercussions for your organization.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001220_KRILE
132.description: I have every confidence in my chosen company, dear and trusted comrades that they are. But I thank you for your concern.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001230_ALPHINAUD
133.description: Krile, it is good to see you.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001240_KRILE
134.description: Likewise! Long voyage notwithstanding, you all seem none the worse for wear.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001250_KRILE
135.description: There is much to discuss, but this is hardly the place. Let's be on our way, shall we?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001280_ESTINIEN
138.description: As your “mercenary,” I should hope my welcome includes a generous salary.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001290_KRILE
139.description: I had to say something, Ser Taciturn!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001300_URIANGER
140.description: Pray forgive me. I was delayed...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001310_YSHTOLA
141.description: It's fine, Urianger. We're all here now.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001320_KRILE
142.description: Let's get down to business then, shall we?

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001330_KRILE
143.description: Come what may, we must prevent the Telophoroi's plans from coming to fruition. At present, I see two paths for gathering the information which may aid us in achieving that goal.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001340_KRILE
144.description: The first involves an investigation into the change which has come over Sharlayan, not to mention the recent, inscrutable behavior of the Forum.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001350_KRILE
145.description: As most of you know, the ninety-nine members of the Forum are elected from the general populace. This alone guarantees a plethora of opinion with regards to foreign policy.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001360_KRILE
146.description: The Bibliothecs, for example, are a group of conservatives which would have Sharlayan focus on recording history, while remaining entirely uninvolved in the making of it.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001370_KRILE
147.description: And at the other extreme, we have advocates for proactive diplomacy and direct intervention. My grandfather, Galuf, was one such member, as was Archon Louisoix.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001380_KRILE
148.description: Yet despite our diverse factions and philosophies, the recent vote to deny Eorzea's request for assistance was unanimous.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001390_KRILE
149.description: Even more concerning was the fact that many cited other, more pressing duties as justification for their recalcitrance.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001400_GRAHATIA
150.description: Fourchenault's refusal in Gridania had those same undertones. 'Twas as if, having stared unblinking into the face of impending doom, he'd simply turned away to pursue something more important. But what could that possibly be?

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001410_KRILE
151.description: A mystery, indeed, and one which I ask for your help to solve. Our future may depend on it.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001420_KRILE
152.description: As for our second potential path, it concerns a request made directly to the Students of Baldesion.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001430_KRILE
153.description: Our organization was founded primarily to study strange and unexplained phenomena the world over. Mysterious relics and ruins, arcane disturbances, and so forth.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001440_KRILE
154.description: Compared to our more isolationist Sharlayan colleagues, we have strong connections overseas─namely with scholars and academics who share our passion for the unknown.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001450_KRILE
155.description: The request in question comes from one such acquaintance─Nidhana, an alchemist residing in distant Thavnair.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001460_KRILE
156.description: Her missive describes the sudden appearance of a tower, and the subsequent summoning of what I can only assume is a lunar primal.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001470_KRILE
157.description: In response to this threat, the satrap of Radz-at-Han─the individual who governs the city-state─has instructed the alchemists to find a means to deal with the spire.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001480_URIANGER
158.description: The artisans of that land are heirs to an ancient tradition─one rather unlike that of their Ul'dahn counterparts.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001490_URIANGER
159.description: 'Tis possible─nay, probable─that they have gleaned truths unattainable by Eorzea or her Far Eastern allies.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001500_KRILE
160.description: They do, in fact, appear to have a strategy in mind, though it will require further research. To that end, they have requested an introduction to a capable warrior shielded by the blessing of Light.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001510_YSHTOLA
161.description: Assuming we divide our forces to pursue both of Krile's lines of inquiry, then having you join the group heading to Thavnair would seem the obvious choice.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001520_YSHTOLA
162.description: But the investigation in Sharlayan is of vital importance as well. Equal, I think, to the Thavnairian one, given that the fate of the world may hinge on the results of both.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001530_KRILE
163.description: Yes, it is quite the quandary.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001540_KRILE
164.description: Though it is a great imposition─and an altogether-too-common one─our efforts would be more likely to succeed were you to lead the charge on both fronts.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001550_KRILE
165.description: You are indeed our champion. As to which task to tackle first, we will defer to your decision. Let us next decide how everyone else might best be assigned.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001560_KRILE
166.description: As for myself, I shall continue what I've begun in Sharlayan. I should also like to steal the services of an Archon or two.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001570_YSHTOLA
167.description: And thereby gain access to a greater range of reading material. I will help with that.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001580_GRAHATIA
168.description: Allow me to offer my assistance. I have some small amount of experience in the field of research.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001590_ALPHINAUD
169.description: Alisaie and I would also like to help, if you would have us.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001600_ALISAIE
170.description: Anything to understand even a fraction of what our father and the Forum might be thinking.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001610_KRILE
171.description: Of course, the more the merrier!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001620_THANCRED
172.description: Right, the rest of us will make the journey to Thavnair.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001640_ESTINIEN
174.description: I passed through Thavnair on my way to infiltrate the Empire, and though I'm not qualified to give a guided tour, I did gain a sense of where things lie.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001650_THANCRED
175.description: I'll be happy to have you along then. So for this group, it will be you, me, and Urianger.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001660_KRILE
176.description: Give me a moment afterwards, and I'll supply you with all the details of Nidhana's request.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001670_KRILE
177.description: Consider this hall our rendezvous point once our respective tasks are complete. May our investigations prove fruitful!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001680_ALISAIE
178.description: When our father disowned us, I couldn't believe what I was hearing.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001690_ALISAIE
179.description: It wasn't until much later that his words began to sink in. That I began to feel the weight of what it meant.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001700_ALISAIE
180.description: Do you remember when the decision was made to come to Sharlayan?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001710_ALISAIE
181.description: G'raha said that the Forum was determined to keep us in the dark, and that Father's venomous “performance” was part of that strategy. To keep us at arm's length.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001720_ALISAIE
182.description: Perhaps it was. Father argued with Grandfather on many occasions, but never with such...dismissive contempt.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001730_ALISAIE
183.description: And...when he demanded what justifies the sacrifices we make in war...I honestly didn't know what to say.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001740_ALISAIE
184.description: Neither did Alphinaud, I know, but...never, for one moment, did I believe we had made the wrong choice. So all I could do was fume silently.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001750_ALISAIE
185.description: It was only afterwards that I realized how childish I had been. How being stubborn and self-righteous must run in the family.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001760_ALISAIE
186.description: If I could've just mustered a civil response, then things might've turned out differently...

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001770_ALISAIE
187.description: They must be ferrying goods to Labyrinthos.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001780_ALISAIE
188.description: A vast complex beneath the island.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001790_ALISAIE
189.description: Sharlayan is famous for archiving knowledge from around the world. Well, that knowledge is not preserved exclusively in dusty tomes and desiccated samples.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001800_ALISAIE
190.description: Our “living” library─comprised of all manner of flora and fauna─is housed and studied within that underground facility.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001810_ALISAIE
191.description: ...Still, that did seem to be an unusually large shipment. When I lived here, it was rare to even see such cargo transported by boat.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001820_ALISAIE
192.description: Wait. Didn't you hear something in the Last Stand about the gleaners coming and going more than usual?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001830_ALISAIE
193.description: I think they're the ones we saw manning those boats. And gleaners answer to the Forum...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001840_ALISAIE
194.description: If the appearance of the Telophoroi prompted this sudden burst of activity, then Labyrinthos may hold a clue as to what the Forum is planning!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001850_EMETSELCH
195.description: Deep beneath the scholars' city shines a false sun within a fabricated sky.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001860_EMETSELCH
196.description: In any age exist those who consider the floor an extension of their bookshelves, and this vault's architects surely belonged to that special breed.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001870_EMETSELCH
197.description: If the stack grows too high, start a new one. If no room remains, then make more rooms.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001880_EMETSELCH
198.description: A simple solution at first. And then, bit by bit...a profound transformation.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001890_EMETSELCH
199.description: Knowledge buried beneath knowledge─a growing, creeping labyrinth from which there is no escape.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001900_KRILE
200.description: Not what you expected? I must admit, the artifice is very convincing.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001910_KRILE
201.description: But I assure you that we are beneath Sharlayan itself. The breeze you feel, the flowing waters you hear─all created by the hand of man.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001920_YSHTOLA
202.description: The island is volcanic, you see, and once upon a time this great hollow must have been a reservoir for magma.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001930_YSHTOLA
203.description: It was discovered some four hundred years ago, at which point it was repurposed as a storage facility for scrolls and samples and such. Renovations have continued with nigh on no interruption to this day, with the lower levels still undergoing expansion.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001950_ALPHINAUD
205.description: Aye, judging by their dress. They are said to work alone, as a rule, but 'twould seem that rule is being enthusiastically broken today.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001960_ALPHINAUD
206.description: It may be as you suspected─that they are engaged in a task apart from the norm.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001970_ALISAIE
207.description: Let's spread out and get some answers, then!

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_001990_KRILE
209.description: Did you call to me just now?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002000_KRILE
210.description: No? How odd. I must be a bit dizzy from the descent.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002010_KRILE
211.description: I-I'll be fine, I'm sure. Let's get to work, shall we?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002030_ERENVILLE
213.description: Nicely done! Let me truss this one up, and I'll make my way over to you.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002040_KRILE
214.description: There you are. Any new revelations?

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002050_ALISAIE
215.description: So you met with that gleaner again, this time to...capture a hornbill?

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002060_ALISAIE
216.description: I understand catching and bringing in creatures from the outside, but what's the point of chasing after ones already here?

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002070_ERENVILLE
217.description: Oh, it's a simple thing, really.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002080_ERENVILLE
218.description: Occasionally, we remove specimens no longer needed for study, or those we've had difficulty raising. But we can't simply turn them loose.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002090_ERENVILLE
219.description: Safely returning such creatures to their native habitats is another facet of a gleaner's duties.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002100_ERENVILLE
220.description: But not in this case, I'm afraid. I've been asked to bring the bird “below.”

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002110_YSHTOLA
221.description: The restricted section in the lower levels of Labyrinthos. Open only to a select few researchers handpicked by the Forum.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002120_YSHTOLA
222.description: The projects down there are the subject of rumor and hearsay. Forbidden magicks. Advanced technologies that can never be allowed to fall into outside hands. Even Archons are not privy to the truth.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002130_YSHTOLA
223.description: Those who are─the researchers involved in this secretive work─are not permitted to walk freely in the city, and are instead required to live in isolated quarters.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002140_ALPHINAUD
224.description: What could a facility subject to such strict security protocols possibly need with a hornbill? An...an experiment?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002150_ERENVILLE
225.description: Possibly. I wasn't afforded an explanation.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002160_ERENVILLE
226.description: But judging by the requisition list given to me and my colleagues, I doubt it's for any kind of advanced research.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002170_ERENVILLE
227.description: I'd be more inclined to believe we were making preparations to migrate to the south. Meracydia or thereabouts.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002180_ALISAIE
228.description: What? Why would you say that?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002190_ERENVILLE
229.description: Much of the flora and fauna we were asked to procure could serve as reliable sources of sustenance.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002200_ERENVILLE
230.description: They're comparatively hardy species, too. Able to endure harsh climates. And among them are specimens known to be effective in improving soil quality and purifying water.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002210_ALISAIE
231.description: When you put it that way, migration does sound like a reasonable assumption.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002220_ERENVILLE
232.description: That's all it is, though─an assumption. Through our tasks, we gleaners glimpse only bits and pieces of the Forum's plans.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002230_ERENVILLE
233.description: Our prime concern is that our requisitions, be they living or otherwise, are properly preserved for the knowledge of future generations.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002240_ERENVILLE
234.description: Now, I really must be going. I regret that I cannot reward you as you deserve.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002250_YSHTOLA
235.description: Perhaps you might reward us after a fashion, then? It is imperative that we reach the lower levels.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002260_YSHTOLA
236.description: And seeing as you are already set to descend with your assigned cargo, mayhap we could accompany you as your...assistants?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002270_ERENVILLE
237.description: I am afraid that won't be possible. Once the animals have been prepared for transport, we send them down separately via the lift.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002280_ERENVILLE
238.description: I will, of course, follow after to make my report, but I can hardly pass you off as porters when there is nothing left to carry.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002300_ERENVILLE
240.description: How do you feel about climbing? If you've strength and the courage to brave it, then there is another way down.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002310_ERENVILLE
241.description: This path leads to the thirty-third facet─a mineshaft excavated during one of our expansions of Labyrinthos.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002320_ERENVILLE
242.description: While I cannot guarantee that the passage is safe to traverse, it should provide access to the Medial Circuit below.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002330_KRILE
243.description: I never even knew such a place existed! Thank you, this is the perfect solution.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002340_ERENVILLE
244.description: You're quite welcome, but consider yourselves warned. If the going proves too treacherous, you'd do well to turn back. I bid you good day.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002350_ALISAIE
245.description: Well, turning back is hardly an option, not when we've come this far. Let's go and take a look at this mineshaft.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002370_BOTANISTMAN
247.description: But they're more than pretty flowers. “Heartblooms” are attuned to ambient emotion.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002390_BOTANISTMAN
249.description: You don't seem convinced. But believe me, it's true.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002400_BOTANISTMAN
250.description: This ashen grey, for instance. It mirrors the anxiety and urgency of those working nearby as they rush to fulfill sudden orders.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002410_BOTANISTMAN
251.description: Intense feelings like those spur the petals to change color. Bright, glowing hues in the presence of joy. Dark, subdued shades for frustration or despair.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002420_BOTANISTMAN
252.description: Yet even with the collected wisdom of Sharlayan at our disposal, we've yet to identify the underlying principle of this empathic effect.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002430_BOTANISTMAN
253.description: And there are other mysteries besides. Although the flower is extraordinarily long-lived, its low reproductive rate has made it difficult to find younger populations growing in the wild.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002440_BOTANISTMAN
254.description: With too few sightings to map its distribution, and no closely related species to track, we've been unable to pinpoint its land of origin.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002450_BOTANISTMAN
255.description: To further complicate matters, every culture even dimly aware of its existence has given it a different name and mythos. Our attempts to study it via the historical record have been an exercise in frustration.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002460_BOTANISTMAN
256.description: As an avid botanist myself, I should one day like to unravel the heartbloom's secrets...but I'm afraid other duties must take precedence. I will leave you to your thoughts.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002470_YSHTOLA
257.description: Have you learned aught of interest?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002480_YSHTOLA
258.description: A flower that reacts to one's feelings? Strange... I must say, I have never heard of such a thing.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002490_ALISAIE
259.description: This is all very fascinating, but as it stands, we've failed to gain any significant insight into the Forum's undertaking.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002500_ALPHINAUD
260.description: Indeed... While there is certainly enough activity to support Erenville's supposition that a priority has been placed on improving food production...

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002510_ALPHINAUD
261.description: Unfortunately for our investigation, these workers were never informed as to how their duties serve the master plan.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002520_ALISAIE
262.description: Ugh. If only we could interrogate the Forum members directly.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002530_ALISAIE
263.description: Isn't that the entrance to the Archeion?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002540_ALISAIE
264.description: Look, there... I think that's Erenville.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002550_ALPHINAUD
265.description: A little difficult to tell from here, but...but I think you're right. He did say he was coming down to make his report.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002560_YSHTOLA
266.description: Erenville receives his orders from the Forum. Would it not follow, then, that the superior to whom he reports is a Forum member─or at least a close associate?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002570_ALPHINAUD
267.description: You mean to eavesdrop on their conversation!? What of the risks?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002580_YSHTOLA
268.description: Ours alone to bear. We won't interfere with Erenville's work, nor will he be implicated as an accomplice.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002590_YSHTOLA
269.description: If you're not comfortable taking part, I can do this alone.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002600_ALPHINAUD
270.description: Nay. I said myself that I wished to know Father's intentions. And no answers will be forthcoming should we simply ask nicely.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002610_ALISAIE
271.description: We can apologize later should it come to it. Right now, we need every crumb of information we can get our hands on. Consequences be damned.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002620_YSHTOLA
272.description: It might be best if you came along as well. In fact, we should all...

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002650_KRILE
275.description: Oh! Yes! That certainly sounds like a plan!

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002670_ALISAIE
277.description: Quickly, Erenville is on the move. We need to get closer before we lose him!

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002680_KRILE
278.description: Almost. I can almost reach you...

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002700_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
279.description: I trust you will find your compensation to be more than satisfactory. We wish to make clear that we are pleased with the efficiency and thoroughness of your work.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002710_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
280.description: So much so that we have come bearing new tasks in need of your competent hand.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002730_ERENVILLE
282.description: If I may speak frankly. The gleaners have been pushed to the point of collapse by your unending demands.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002740_ERENVILLE
283.description: We are not familiars to be exploited. We are Sharlayan scholars, and we deserve an explanation for this unseemly treatment. What warrants such urgency?

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002750_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
284.description: ...In an age long past, Sharlayan was charged with a momentous duty.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002760_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
285.description: And now that word of the Final Days hangs heavy in the air, the time has come for us to fulfill that charge.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002770_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
286.description: I can say no more, but I promise you this: all will be revealed in due course. And when it has, you will understand that your toil was in service to the greatest good.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002780_ERENVILLE
287.description: Then I will do your bidding. For now.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002790_ERENVILLE
288.description: But unless you wish the gleaners to rise up in protest, I advise you to offer tangible improvements for our working conditions. Your promised revelation does nothing to address present circumstances.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002800_REQUESTEDLEGISLATOR
289.description: A fair point. Your concerns will be conveyed to the Forum.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002810_ERENVILLE
290.description: I hope that was informative. You may consider my debt to you repaid in full.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002820_ERENVILLE
291.description: While I do have my reservations about the Forum, I want to believe that they have our best interests at heart.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002830_ERENVILLE
292.description: Which is why I'm reassured that you're busy sniffing out the truth of things. We can ill afford to place all our eggs in one basket─this master plan of theirs─without first understanding the risks involved.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002840_ALISAIE
293.description: Wait, how did you know it was us?

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002850_ERENVILLE
294.description: If you mean to impersonate a toad, try studying the real thing. And don't try to fool an expert.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002860_KRILE
295.description: For you. The spell will keep it from wilting.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002870_KRILE
296.description: She said you would need it for the journey ahead.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002880_KRILE
297.description: Will you speak with Her now? I cannot hope to match Minfilia's clarity, of course, but...

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002910_HYDAELYN
300.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Do not worry. She has lent me her body for only a moment.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002920_HYDAELYN
301.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Just as I could not save the First from the Flood of Light, it has become arduous for me to interact with the physical world without assistance.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002930_HYDAELYN
302.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Though I might converse with you for a time, the incorporeal form I assumed on the ship would be incapable of casting even the simplest enchantment.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002940_HYDAELYN
303.description: (-Hydaelyn-)It is in the depths of the aetherial sea─the place to which all life returns─where my influence is greatest.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002950_HYDAELYN
304.description: (-Hydaelyn-)After Minfilia's sacrifice on the First, it was to the sea, here in the Source, where I ferried her soul. I wished that gentle spirit to find rest in the world she loved so well.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002960_HYDAELYN
305.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Her...and another who may yet have a part to play. Though that will depend on you.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002970_HYDAELYN
306.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Take the flower. Walk free. For you are free─to go where you wish. To believe what you will.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002980_HYDAELYN
307.description: (-Hydaelyn-)That bloom will be your guide. Test and proof of your conviction.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_002990_HYDAELYN
308.description: (-Hydaelyn-)In darkness seek joy. Surrender not to sadness, and see beyond despair. Walk free, and bear the light for others to follow.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003000_HYDAELYN
309.description: (-Hydaelyn-)Together, raise it aloft and let it shine. Till the end, blinding and radiant.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003010_KRILE
310.description: That was...all too brief. Already She seems so far away...

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003020_KRILE
311.description: My apologies if I startled you. Ever since we began our descent into Labyrinthos, I had sensed another's will, straining to reach out.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003030_KRILE
312.description: Even with my particular talents, though, I was unable to make a connection at first. So weak and tenuous it was...

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003040_KRILE
313.description: Once I took hold of that wispy thread, imagine my surprise to discover it was Hydaelyn Herself! Needless to say, it seemed wise to learn what we could before letting go.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003050_KRILE
314.description: Her answers were more cryptic than I would have liked... But at least She left us with a guide of sorts─that unusual flower.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003060_KRILE
315.description: Yes, we are definitely making progress!

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003070_ALISAIE
316.description: You can't be serious! We've done nothing wrong!

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003080_KRILE
317.description: Master Fourchenault!? What business has the Forum with us?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003100_FOURCHENAULT
319.description: Mistress Baldesion. Our records show you facilitated the Scions' entrance into Sharlayan by claiming them as assistants for your organization.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003110_FOURCHENAULT
320.description: We are aware of your “investigations.” After alerting the major institutions to the presence of potential troublemakers, we received word from an Archeion custodian.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003120_FOURCHENAULT
321.description: A group operating under the auspices of the Students skulking about Labyrinthos and engaging in clandestine behavior.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003130_ALPHINAUD
322.description: “Clandestine”? We may not have entered Sharlayan as Scions, but we did naught to conceal our identities.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003140_ALPHINAUD
323.description: Our only purpose in this city is to seek the truth. I can think of no reason why our actions should warrant the Forum's intervention.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003150_FOURCHENAULT
324.description: 'Tis not our way to discourage the pursuit of knowledge. But the timing of such pursuits must be considered, not to mention their potential impact.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003160_FOURCHENAULT
325.description: With the world in chaos, we, the true caretakers of wisdom, have committed ourselves to an undertaking that demands the utmost discretion.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003170_FOURCHENAULT
326.description: And we will not risk its success by turning a blind eye to disruptive foreign elements in our midst.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003180_YSHTOLA
327.description: What, then, is to be our fate? Will you put us on a ship back to Eorzea?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003190_FOURCHENAULT
328.description: The Forum will convene to examine your case. The results of said inquiry will determine your future in this city.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003200_FOURCHENAULT
329.description: As for your absent companion, he has already been detained.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003210_ALISAIE
330.description: G'raha!? But why? Is reading a crime now, too!?

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003220_FOURCHENAULT
331.description: Reading is encouraged. Celebrated, even. Not, however, of the volumes shelved in the restricted section of the library.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003230_YSHTOLA
332.description: Refusing to comply will only make matters worse. Let us instead treat this as an opportunity to open a dialogue with the Forum.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003240_FOURCHENAULT
333.description: Silence is often one's best defense. I would advise against prolonging the proceedings with frivolous discourse.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003250_FOURCHENAULT
334.description: But enough─this is not the place for debate. The Rostra awaits.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003270_YSHTOLA
336.description: We would have been detained regardless. This way, at least, we manage to stay together.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003280_YSHTOLA
337.description: I trust your time within the forbidden archives was well spent?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003290_BARNIER
338.description: The Forum will come to order!

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003300_BARNIER
339.description: This inquiry is now in session. As Speaker Elect, I will be presiding over the day's proceedings.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003310_BARNIER
340.description: Master Fourchenault. Would you be so kind as to restate the matter which compelled you to summon your colleagues with such urgency?

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003320_FOURCHENAULT
341.description: As you are all aware, we recently denied Eorzea's request for Sharlayan assistance.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003330_FOURCHENAULT
342.description: Since then, certain individuals dissatisfied with our decision have taken it upon themselves to interfere with our work.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003340_FOURCHENAULT
343.description: They entered our nation masquerading as associates of the Students of Baldesion, but these malcontents are better known as the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003350_FOURCHENAULT
344.description: These militants wield influence with both the Eorzean and Eastern alliances, and are inextricably involved with the crises presently afflicting the world at large.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003360_FOURCHENAULT
345.description: Loose in our city, these warmongers sought to meddle with and expose matters of state secret. What are they if not a dire threat to be expelled!?

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003370_LEGISLATORA
346.description: You have tarnished the good name of the Students. Galuf would be ashamed...

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003380_KRILE
347.description: Galuf Baldesion was never one to forsake his fellow man.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003390_KRILE
348.description: Even if this nation closed every door and retreated from the world, he would have found a way to help the Scions─help every soul of this star─fight back against the coming doom.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003400_YSHTOLA
349.description: A terrible enemy stands poised to lay waste to all we hold dear. In the face of such madness, Eorzea reached out to Sharlayan, a respected ally, in the hopes of forming a united front.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003410_YSHTOLA
350.description: Was your curt dismissal truly the best you could offer?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003420_YSHTOLA
351.description: Or are you so preoccupied with your “momentous duty of an age long past” that even the end of the world is unworthy of your attention?

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003440_YSHTOLA
353.description: From the mouth of a Forum member within fortuitous earshot.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003450_YSHTOLA
354.description: From the mouth of a Forum member within fortuitous earshot.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003460_GRAHATIA
355.description: Then it seems your findings support my own...

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003470_GRAHATIA
356.description: The reason I visited the restricted shelves was to study records of the Forum's policy-making process. To better understand the historical trends underlying their most major decisions.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003480_GRAHATIA
357.description: At first glance, the positions of neutrality in war and the accumulation of knowledge above all else appear constant and consistent─the unchanging pillars of Sharlayan society.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003490_GRAHATIA
358.description: And once upon a time, I might have left it at that. These days, however, I am more attuned to the subtleties of governance, and so I noticed something...odd.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003500_GRAHATIA
359.description: From a particular point in time, the purpose of these policies shifted.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003510_GRAHATIA
360.description: No longer was knowledge preserved for the benefit of society. Rather, society was to be gradually reshaped to ensure the preservation of knowledge.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003520_GRAHATIA
361.description: The most conspicuous and telling change was the one which befell Labyrinthos. Once little more than an oversized storehouse, an enormous allocation of funds saw it transformed into an advanced research and archival facility.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003530_GRAHATIA
362.description: I also discovered a fascinating account on the finances of our Dravanian colony.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003540_GRAHATIA
363.description: The settlement attracted students from far and wide, and the connections and tuition fees thus acquired were funneled into further improvements for the archives.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003550_GRAHATIA
364.description: Now, there is no question that our nation's progress is tied to the acquisition of wisdom. Nevertheless, the vast resources diverted for this purpose borders on the obscene.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003560_GRAHATIA
365.description: But returning to the matter of when─our change in course appears to have been made some two hundred and seventy years ago...

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003570_YSHTOLA
366.description: The very same period when Sharlayan scholars in the hinterlands began a formal study of the aetherial sea!

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003580_YSHTOLA
367.description: You found something, did you not? And whatever it was gave rise to your oh-so-important duty...

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003590_LEGISLATORB
368.description: Mind your tongue, Archon! If you had seen─!

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003600_FOURCHENAULT
369.description: Yes, we are bound by a duty we cannot ignore.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003610_FOURCHENAULT
370.description: Knowing this, what would you have us do? Abandon our vital work, and join you on the field of battle?

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003620_FOURCHENAULT
371.description: We will never choose the way of the sword. We will fulfill our mission not through strife and bloodshed, but survival.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003630_FOURCHENAULT
372.description: Come what may, we shall live on. We must.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003640_YSHTOLA
373.description: Do as you must then. But we Scions will fight─until the heavens fall, until our last breath.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003670_ALPHINAUD
376.description: I fail to understand the stance you have elected to take. But by the same token, I have yet to find a compelling argument to counter the challenge you put to us in Gridania.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003680_ALPHINAUD
377.description: Still, in the midst of my uncertainty...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003690_ALPHINAUD
378.description: I must trust in myself to do what is right. As others have chosen to trust in me.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003700_ALPHINAUD
379.description: So I will continue as I always have, weighing the consequences of my every action, and allowing my hope for the future to inform my decisions.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003710_MONTICHAIGNE
380.description: That's quite enough! Have you all forgotten the reason for this assembly?

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003720_ALISAIE
381.description: Scholarch Montichaigne. He's the head of the Studium, and an old friend of my grandfather's.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003730_MONTICHAIGNE
382.description: Honestly, every discussion devolves into some interminable debate. Terrible habit. Let's return to the topic at hand, hm?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003740_MONTICHAIGNE
383.description: By their own admission, these Scions have resolved to fight alongside the Eorzean nations against the doom which swift approaches.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003750_MONTICHAIGNE
384.description: But there exists no evidence of an attempt to incite our citizens to do the same.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003760_MONTICHAIGNE
385.description: Furthermore, while our decision may well've been the correct one, we cannot simply bull our way through these disagreements without inviting doubts or objections.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003770_MONTICHAIGNE
386.description: Put yourselves in their place! Who among you would leave a tome unopened if an elder forbid you read it with no reason given?

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003780_MONTICHAIGNE
387.description: No, if we're to quell further discontent, then we must conclude this matter with a fair and even hand.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003800_BARNIER
389.description: Master Montichaigne raises some valid points. Keeping such concerns in mind, I propose we enforce the following measures.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003810_BARNIER
390.description: Until further notice, the Students of Baldesion are to cease any and all activities within the domain of Sharlayan.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003820_BARNIER
391.description: You will also refrain from any further investigation into the Forum's decisions and duties. Failure to comply with these restrictions will result in the immediate expulsion of your Scion associates.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003830_BARNIER
392.description: Let us put this judgment to a vote. All in favor, raise your hand!

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003840_BARNIER
393.description: I count fifty-one for, and forty-eight against. The proposal is passed.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003850_BARNIER
394.description: Students, Scions, you have heard the Forum's judgment. Pray abide by it or face the consequences.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003860_BARNIER
395.description: Honored members, I thank you for your time. This inquiry is concluded!

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003890_ALISAIE
398.description: What? What are you gawping at?

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
400.description: House Leveilleur in all its grandeur!

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
401.description: Scion headquarters must seem squalid indeed...

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003900_ALISAIE
403.description: Oh gods, please don't! It makes me feel like a spoiled princess.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003910_ALISAIE
404.description: I'll have you know I'm quite fond of the Rising Stones!

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003920_ALISAIE
405.description: Oh, I...I suppose I never gave the décor much thought. I'm glad that you approve. I think.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003930_AMELIANCE
406.description: Lord Fourchenault is not to hear of this visit.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003940_AMELIANCE
407.description: And I should also like the children to have their gifts ere my husband makes his return.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003960_EMPLOYEEWOMAN
409.description: Master Alphinaud, Mistress Alisaie, if you would accompany me upstairs...?

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003980_AMELIANCE
411.description: The twins have been sending letters home from time to time, recounting their latest adventures.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_003990_AMELIANCE
412.description: I am sure they withhold certain details, of course. If only to keep me from worrying...

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004000_AMELIANCE
413.description: Yet a mother worries all the same. In the early days especially, I tried to support them as best I could, sending the Scions coin and other such donations.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004010_AMELIANCE
414.description: Fortunately, they have found the strength to overcome adversity time and time again. Their words grow more confident with every letter, their depictions more vivid.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004020_AMELIANCE
415.description: The triumphs and defeats. The joys and sorrows. 'Tis clear that they have come to find value in every experience.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004030_AMELIANCE
416.description: But of those they treasure most, it would seem that meeting you might be the most impactful. Why, since that fateful day, I do believe there has not been a single missive in which you were not mentioned by name!

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004050_AMELIANCE
418.description: 'Tis plain they care for you. And I am glad they have such a steadfast companion watching over them.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004060_AMELIANCE
419.description: Under normal circumstances I would offer you tea, but alas, these are anything but. In any event, why don't you keep me company whilst we await my children's return? Perhaps you might regale me with a tale or two of your exploits?

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004070_ALISAIE
420.description: When you mentioned gifts, I wasn't sure what to expect.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004090_AMELIANCE
422.description: Oh, look how well it fits you! And the style is to your liking?

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004100_ALISAIE
423.description: It's perfect─exactly what I would have chosen! But please, tell me you had something different made for Alphinaud...

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004110_AMELIANCE
424.description: Naturally! You are hardly little children anymore.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004120_AMELIANCE
425.description: And while I shall miss dressing you in those precious matching outfits, I must respect the individuals you have grown to become.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004140_ALPHINAUD
427.description: Thank you for the splendid clothes, Mother. Stylish, comfortable, and eminently practical!

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004150_AMELIANCE
428.description: I am so glad you like them. They are, however, missing one final touch.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004160_EMPLOYEEWOMAN
429.description: If you would allow me, Master Alphinaud...

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004180_AMELIANCE
431.description: ...A sage's tools of the trade. They belonged to your father.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004190_AMELIANCE
432.description: Though he may as well be chained to his desk these days, as a student, he was often called upon to venture into the field.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004200_AMELIANCE
433.description: He wielded those armaments, both to heal and to harm, in no few battles. None so fierce as those you two have braved, perhaps, but battles nonetheless.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004210_AMELIANCE
434.description: Thus did I pull them out of storage─to show you that he was not always the man who stands in vehement opposition to you now.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004220_AMELIANCE
435.description: And also because it would be a terrible waste of ridiculously expensive, House Leveilleur-commissioned artistry.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004230_AMELIANCE
436.description: I am told these devices are quite difficult to master, but someone of your extensive experience should soon have them darting about with grace and aplomb.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004240_AMELIANCE
437.description: May the wisdom in that crystal serve you well. And please, try to find common ground with your father, that you might come and go without need for this awful subterfuge.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004260_AMELIANCE
439.description: My final gifts to you, before you run off, are an observation and a suggestion.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004270_AMELIANCE
440.description: Firstly, Fourchenault has ever been a serious man, but it was only after you were born that he truly lost himself in his work.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004280_AMELIANCE
441.description: I may not know the Forum's inner workings, but I know your father's. The timing of that change in him holds some significance.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004290_AMELIANCE
442.description: Secondly, do not seek to best your father with words.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004300_AMELIANCE
443.description: Far better that you simply show him─let him discover the merit of your actions <hex:021A020203>after<hex:021A020103> they cannot be undone!

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004320_ALPHINAUD
447.description: We shall take your wisdom to heart. Thank you again for these gifts, and farewell for now!

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004330_AMELIANCE
448.description: Safe travels, my children. Eat well, stay warm, and keep your friends close.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004350_KYTTE
450.description: Just the four of you, was it?

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004360_ESTINIEN
451.description: Three. I am already attuned to the crystal in Thavnair.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004370_KYTTE
452.description: You are? Oh. I would have preferred more test subjects...

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004380_KYTTE
453.description: Oh well, never mind. If our three travelers could line up here, please?

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004390_KYTTE
454.description: Yes, right there is fine! Take a deep breath, and I'll soon have you soaring through the aether.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004410_KYTTE
456.description: You might experience a teensy-weensy touch of violent aetherial sickness. Good luck!

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004440_EMETSELCH
459.description: Rising from the southeast waters of the Bounty, this isle of plenty served as the battleground for a conflict between two peoples.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004450_EMETSELCH
460.description: Their cultures bled into one another until a unique amalgamation was distilled from the chaos, in a process not unlike their precious alchemy.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004460_EMETSELCH
461.description: Once solidified as a single nation, an adamant stance of neutrality would hold invaders at bay. For a time.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004470_EMETSELCH
462.description: Now across this vibrant isle creeps a fog of malice. What choice do you have...

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004500_ESTINIEN
465.description: I've seen fairer faces after a bout of bad shellfish.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004510_ESTINIEN
466.description: Let me bring you something to drink. That should help settle your bellies.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004520_THANCRED
467.description: There was a note...with Krile's instructions...

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004530_THANCRED
468.description: Don't let Estinien roam the markets alone... He's alarmingly bad with coin...

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004570_THANCRED
472.description: Their dress marks them as alchemists. I see no evidence of injury or poison.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004590_THANCRED
474.description: I believe so. Whether it is by <hex:021A020203>choice<hex:021A020103> is another question entirely.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004610_VARSHAHN
476.description: (-???-)You must excuse the poor welcome. Long days and longer nights have taken their toll, as you can see...

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004620_VARSHAHN
477.description: I am Varshahn. Servant to the satrap. My task was, in fact, to wake these good men and women. If you will allow.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004630_VARSHAHN
478.description: People of the Great Work! I come bearing new scales!

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004660_VARSHAHN
481.description: Yes, my friends. Gather round. I have them right here.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004670_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
482.description: Oh, happy day! Now I can continue my experiment!

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004710_VARSHAHN
486.description: Yes─such materials are vital to their most pressing research.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004720_NIDHANA
487.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)And we are fortunate to have them. Our experiments are so close to bearing fruit...

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004730_NIDHANA
488.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)Soon we will have a talisman capable of nullifying the aetheric emissions from that accursed tower!

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004740_NIDHANA
489.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)Did...did I say something wrong? Are you not here with Varshahn? Wait, who <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> you people?

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004750_NIDHANA
490.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)Of course! You're the one Krile sent─the “Warrior of Light” we've been waiting for!

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004760_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
491.description: This is a day of celebration! Praise be to Cinduruva!

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004770_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKB
492.description: The winds have shifted. I feel it! The end to our toil is near!

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004780_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKC
493.description: I feel it, too. My head hasn't been this clear in days...

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004790_ESTINIEN
494.description: Tell me, how did you acquire those scales?

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004800_VARSHAHN
495.description: Curious that it concerns you so.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004810_VARSHAHN
496.description: But worry not. They were freely given by the dragon with whom our satrap has forged a lawful pact.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004830_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
498.description: You must be quite familiar with dragonkin, yes?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004840_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKB
499.description: Is this their congealed blood I see on your weapon?

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004850_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKC
500.description: Hrm... Speaking of dragon blood...you yourself have been infused with it, have you not?

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004860_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKC
501.description: I should like to draw a phial or two, if so!

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004880_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
503.description: Come along, come along! I must <hex:021A020203>insist<hex:021A020103> that you visit our laboratory!

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004890_ESTINIEN
504.description: Cease your shoving, or so help me...!

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004900_NIDHANA
505.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)Oh dear, your poor companion. What with the new scales and your timely arrival, my colleagues are a little giddy with excitement.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004910_NIDHANA
506.description: (-Arkasodara Alchemist-)No harm will come to him, I promise! Meanwhile, shall we find a quiet place to talk?

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004920_NIDHANA
507.description: As you may have guessed, I am Nidhana─the alchemist who sent the request to your Mistress Krile. We have workshops across the nation collaborating on this research project, but it is here─at the Great Work─where I collate our results.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004930_NIDHANA
508.description: Come with me, all of you, and I can explain the crux of the situation.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004940_NIDHANA
509.description: Yes, that would be Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. Hardly anyone has been allowed in or out since our troubles with the tower began.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004950_NIDHANA
510.description: The fearful citizens huddle inside the city walls, and commerce has all but ground to a standstill. I pity the satrap the trials he must be facing.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
512.description: What can you tell me of the satrap?

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004960_NIDHANA
514.description: Well, he... He is the most important person in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004970_NIDHANA
515.description: Completely! Without the satrap and his line, Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han would not exist.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004980_NIDHANA
516.description: Long ago, this island was home to two tribes of Matanga─the Gajasura, and the Arkasodara.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_004990_NIDHANA
517.description: When the Au Ra came to these shores, it was the Arkasodara with whom they joined forces. Together, they defeated the warlike Gajasura, forcing them to flee Thavnair altogether.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005000_NIDHANA
518.description: Peace and prosperity reigned for a time, until a clan of Hyur from the mainland decided they wanted the island for themselves.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005010_NIDHANA
519.description: It was a direct ancestor of the present satrap who arbitrated that conflict, and welded the warring factions into the nation we know today.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005020_NIDHANA
520.description: And ever since, a member of that esteemed lineage has inherited this somewhat unique position. You see, by and large, the state is run by the people, but when problems arise, it is the satrap who mediates a solution.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005030_NIDHANA
521.description: The stability provided by the satrap is what has allowed Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han to thrive all these years.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005040_NIDHANA
522.description: And it was the satrap himself who entrusted us with this duty. We will not fail him, nor our countrymen!

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005050_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
523.description: What is the delay with the vessel!? I told you, I need to adjust those ratios!

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005060_FANDANIEL
524.description: I come all this way to admire one of my splendid towers, and what do I find? Fools attempting to ward off its tempering influence with magic trinkets.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005070_FANDANIEL
525.description: I seem to recall a similar experiment in ages past. What <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> that man's name...?

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005090_FANDANIEL
527.description: Another body, another time. Who could be expected to remember every trivial detail...

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005100_AMON
528.description: Another body, another time. Who could be expected to remember every trivial detail...

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005110_AMON
529.description: Hmmm. Allowing them to construct such handy talismans would be counterproductive to my plans...

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005120_AMON
530.description: And yet, I find myself deathly curious. How <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> they manage this feat with the limited knowledge and resources at their disposal?

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005130_AMON
531.description: Complications be damned. For we cannot escape the nature of our souls. And I, as ever, am my own worst enemy.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005140_THANCRED
532.description: I see our taskmasters have allowed you a moment's respite as well.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005150_THANCRED
533.description: You have to hand it to these alchemists─they are determined to see this endeavor of theirs succeed.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005160_THANCRED
534.description: I've never been one for blind optimism, but I sincerely get the sense they're close to a breakthrough.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005170_ESTINIEN
535.description: They had better be, or all this effort was for naught...

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005180_URIANGER
536.description: The peoples of Eorzea, of the Far East, of Thavnair... Children of this star united in common cause against a dire threat.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005190_URIANGER
537.description: Yet ere they succumbed to suicidal madness, were not the Telophoroi born of Her body, as were we?

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005200_URIANGER
538.description: They who cling to life and the promise of the morrow's dawn, 'gainst they who desire death and an ending of their own orchestration.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005210_URIANGER
539.description: The victors of this war alone will hold the right to answer the question of existence. Of its meaning, and its worth.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005220_THANCRED
540.description: Poetic and ominous to a fault. That said, if it's an existential debate in nature, then our arguments might not be as persuasive as you'd think.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005230_THANCRED
541.description: Fandaniel wants to die, and take everyone with him in an orgy of pain and suffering. An utterly vile and unforgivable idea.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005240_THANCRED
542.description: And yet, when spat upon by fate and wailing in the deepest pit of despair, who among us can say they have not entertained similar thoughts?

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005250_THANCRED
543.description: There are nights black as pitch. Bereft of hope. When no words of comfort can reach you, and it's all you can do to grit your teeth and choke back the bile.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005260_ESTINIEN
544.description: The more you see and suffer life's injustices, the more difficult they become to bear.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005270_ESTINIEN
545.description: Vengeance is nurtured in similar soil. Though your anger has a broader focus, the sentiment is much the same: a fervent desire to destroy others; to see them drown in torment, as you have.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005280_THANCRED
546.description: That about sums it up. The will to endure is not always as strong as the urge to burn it all down and salt the earth, survival be damned. It's a struggle─often close and brutal.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005290_URIANGER
547.description: Indeed... Well. I, for one, shall pray survival proveth more appealing in the end.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005300_THANCRED
548.description: As will I. Besides, our chances are much improved when we've the company of others committed to the cause of life. Our vengeful dragoon here is proof of that.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005310_THANCRED
549.description: What is it? What did you see?

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005320_THANCRED
550.description: Fandaniel? Are you sure? If he knows we've been working on a countermeasure...

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005330_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKA
551.description: It holds...the vessel holds! This is the one.

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005350_NIDHANA
553.description: Look! We have finally created a talisman strong enough to withstand our experiments!

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005360_NIDHANA
554.description: We've named it a “warding scale”─for the time being. With this in your possession, your soul should be completely shielded from corruptive aether.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005370_URIANGER
555.description: Afforded such protection, any one of us may approach the towers without fear. Thou hast mine admiration─'tis an invention of historical significance.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005380_NIDHANA
556.description: I thank you for your kind words! But I would prefer you keep them unsaid until we test the talisman's efficacy in the field.

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005390_NIDHANA
557.description: It is for the next stage of our plan that we summoned you in the first place: to accompany me to the Tower of Zot.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005400_NIDHANA
558.description: Should the scale prove effective─as I very much hope it will─then you'll have little to do. But should the effect be weaker than anticipated, I must ask that you restrain me. Or knock me senseless.

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
560.description: Let's hope it doesn't come to that.

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005410_NIDHANA
562.description: Either way, we are fortunate to have you with us.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005420_ALCHEMISTOFTHEGREATWORKC
563.description: Nidhana, I... Are you certain you wish to do this?

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005430_NIDHANA
564.description: If others are to trust our creations, then we must have faith in them first. And as the senior researcher, it falls to me to lead by example.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005440_NIDHANA
565.description: But...should I fail to return, then learn what you can from this attempt and apply it to the next. Our work must continue. Is that clear?

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005450_THANCRED
566.description: We'll keep an eye on the place while you're away.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005460_THANCRED
