567.description: Assuming Fandaniel is lurking about, there's no telling what mischief he has in mind for us─or you. Be on your guard.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005470_NIDHANA
568.description: Shall we be on our way? I'll have one of the soldiers at the hatchery prepare us a boat, and we can set out from the northern shore. I'll see you there.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005480_NIDHANA
569.description: We should soon cross the threshold of the tower's influence...

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005510_NIDHANA
572.description: And you─you are still yourself? Then I'd like to see how it fares closer to the tower, if we could.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005520_NIDHANA
573.description: So far, so good. The scale's protection appears to be holding. If we can just make it to the tower's entrance...

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005540_NIDHANA
575.description: Praise be to the Sisters! We made it! And the scale has proven itself to be everything we hoped it would be.

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005550_NIDHANA
576.description: Now we can focus on production. Once we've equipped and returned with an entire survey team, this menace will soon give up its secrets!

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005590_FANDANIEL
580.description: Oh, do calm down. You'll only hurt yourself thrashing about like that.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005600_NIDHANA
581.description: Stop! You can't do this! Please!

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005610_FANDANIEL
582.description: A little late for heroics, I'm afraid.

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005630_FANDANIEL
584.description: My, my, such <hex:021A020203>hostility<hex:021A020103>. Never before has my artistry so displeased.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005640_FANDANIEL
585.description: My patrons of old would've positively squealed in delight! Though, between you and me, I find gushing praise exhausting.

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005650_FANDANIEL
589.description: Allow me to tell you a story. Surely you've yet to hear the one about Fandaniel, the sundered Ascian.

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005660_FANDANIEL
590.description: I inherited the position─and the soul─of the Fandaniel who sat on the Convocation in the time of the Final Days. Theoretically speaking.

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005670_FANDANIEL
591.description: Practically speaking, that fact is of no consequence! I was born and lived as...well. Me.

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005680_FANDANIEL
592.description: Eventually I was recruited into the Ascians and imbued with the former Fandaniel's knowledge and memories, but I never felt that they were truly a part of who I am.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005690_FANDANIEL
593.description: How to explain? Perhaps if I told you who I was before my Ascian embrace. Although that chapter, too, is a past I've long since discarded.

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005700_FANDANIEL
594.description: I have it on good authority you've poked your nose into an Allagan ruin or two, yes?

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005710_FANDANIEL
595.description: Then I expect you've heard of me. The old me.

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005740_AMON
598.description: Imagine a nation of unbridled prosperity.

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005750_AMON
599.description: Every need, met; day after day of unbroken, unshakable peace.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005780_ALLAGMAN
602.description: You are a genius without peer, Amon. How ever do you conceive of such delightful experiments?

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005790_ALLAGMAN
603.description: That fool was beside himself with panic when he awoke with the head of a bull! Even his cries for help emerged as so much guttural lowing!

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005800_ALLAGMAN
604.description: Oh, the memory of it... Haha, my poor sides! My friends and I were so consumed by laughter we struggled to breathe!

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005810_AMON
605.description: No more than entertainment for bored wastrels ignorant of its worth. My all-consuming work...

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005820_AMON
606.description: But it was not their only indulgence.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005830_AMON
607.description: For they were ever hungry for stimulation. Slaves to the slightest hint that amusement was afoot.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005840_AMON
608.description: Our nation was ailing...but I would see the poison purged.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005850_AMON
609.description: I resurrected a legend─our first and greatest emperor.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005860_AMON
610.description: And just as I had planned, he set our wayward empire back on the path of conquest.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005870_AMON
611.description: An inexhaustible ambition carried us onwards, always onwards.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005880_AMON
612.description: Yet he who delivered to us such glory was not to be satisfied.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005900_XANDE
614.description: No matter how vast one's empire, or full one's treasure vault, all is rendered meaningless by death.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005910_XANDE
615.description: In the end, all is lost...

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005920_EMETSELCH
616.description: You know as well as I that the emperor stands to lose this war. And so I have come to claim you.

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005930_EMETSELCH
617.description: For while your methods leave something to be desired, we cannot deny the results of your work.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005940_EMETSELCH
618.description: And as fortune would have it, the seat of Fandaniel─your rightful seat─lies vacant and waiting. Take your place amongst your peers, rather than die a pointless death amidst the ashes of your doomed nation.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005950_EMETSELCH
619.description: Send one of your clones to the Crystal Tower that you might see for yourself.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005970_AMON
621.description: The fall of the empire affirmed the truth. Majestic and tragic...as the emperor foresaw.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005980_AMON
622.description: Scheme as you like, build as you will. Nothing endures.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_005990_AMON
623.description: What is life, but a brief jaunt ending in emptiness?

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006000_FANDANIEL
624.description: (-Fandaniel-)So easily distracted! Why, I almost left without saying farewell.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006010_FANDANIEL
625.description: (-Fandaniel-)As for your friend, you needn't worry─these pawns are far more useful to me alive as fuel for the primals.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006020_FANDANIEL
626.description: (-Fandaniel-)Ah ah ah! If you attempt to pull them free, they <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> die, so─enjoy tackling that conundrum with your comrades!

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006030_FANDANIEL
627.description: (-Fandaniel-)We shall meet again! Not in one of these minor spires, oh no, but somewhere more suitably grandiose. Your favorite playmate is ever so eager to see you.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006040_EMETSELCH
628.description: A vast rock squats upon Thavnair, and to its stony surface clings the city of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006050_EMETSELCH
629.description: Ye who enter here are subject to the scrutiny of gods─the gate's most watchful eye.

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006060_EMETSELCH
630.description: The orb which beholdeth the truth of all things.

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006070_EMETSELCH
631.description: Pass beneath its hot and piercing gaze, bearing down like a second midday sun.

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006080_EMETSELCH
632.description: The fragrant haze a mixture of sweet incense and acrid smoke. The cries of merchants mingled here with lively melodies accented by dancers' feet.

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006090_EMETSELCH
633.description: Travelers seduced by vivid sound and colors were once swallowed up by patchwork streets.

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006100_EMETSELCH
634.description: But no such scenes to savor now. To what somber present does that divine eye bear witness?

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006120_VARSHAHN
636.description: It seems a shame to bring you here directly. Under normal circumstances, it would have been my pleasure to show you the sights.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006130_THANCRED
637.description: And it would have been our pleasure to see them. Alas, it seems our tour of the city will have to wait.

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006140_VARSHAHN
638.description: I am afraid so. Come, we should head inside.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006150_VARSHAHN
639.description: Your Excellency, may I present our honored visitors.

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006170_AWAHEEN
641.description: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Ahewann, satrap of Radz-at-Han.

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006180_AWAHEEN
642.description: Our alchemists tell me your assistance was invaluable in the creation of the warding scale.

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006190_AWAHEEN
643.description: Such deeds ought to be recognized in person, thus did I have young Varshahn convey you here forthwith. On behalf of my people, may I express to you our sincere gratitude.

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006210_AWAHEEN
648.description: I assume you speak of Nidhana? A regrettable incident, indeed.

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006220_AWAHEEN
649.description: Her colleagues insist that we honor her wishes, and trust in the talisman─that it will be instrumental in saving Nidhana and the others.

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006230_AWAHEEN
650.description: I am eager to hear your opinion on the matter, so let us not stand on ceremony. Come, sit.

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006250_ESTINIEN
652.description: This charade has gone on long enough. Show yourself.

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006260_AWAHEEN
653.description: Forgive me, but were you expecting musicians perhaps? There are no performers waiting in the wings at present, but arrangements could be made if you'd prefer─

654.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006270_VRITRA
654.description: (-???-)Nay, he hath the right of it─the time for artifice is past. Raise the curtain.

656.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006290_VRITRA
656.description: (-???-)You travel as assistants to the Students of Baldesion, but you are known to me.

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006300_VRITRA
657.description: (-???-)Even here have we heard of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006310_VRITRA
658.description: I am Vrtra, and for years uncounted hath this isle served as mine abode.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006320_URIANGER
659.description: Vrtra! Of the first brood, sibling to Hraesvelgr and Nidhogg!

660.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006330_VRITRA
660.description: Aye, mine elder brothers. Of Midgardsormr's spawn, I was last to hatch.

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006340_THANCRED
661.description: Well, isn't this a surprise! We were told Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han had an alliance with a dragon, not that a great wyrm sat in the satrap's own hall...

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006350_AWAHEEN
662.description: A necessary subterfuge, as the true tale of our nation's history illustrates most effectively.

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006360_AWAHEEN
663.description: In the beginning, the rock upon which our city is built was home to Vrtra, and Vrtra alone.

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006370_AWAHEEN
664.description: In time, the ancestors of the Matanga came to the island and established a foothold, but never did they dare disturb the wyrm's lair.

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006380_AWAHEEN
665.description: Next to arrive were the Au Ra. Adopting the example of their Arkasodara allies, they too treated Vrtra with reverence and respect.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006390_AWAHEEN
666.description: And for many years, an understanding between our forefathers and the great wyrm endured...

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006400_AWAHEEN
667.description: ...Until marauding Hyurs from the mainland came, threatening to shatter our peace and tranquility.

668.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006410_AWAHEEN
668.description: When it seemed all would be drowned in blood, Vrtra himself came forth and quelled the rising conflict.

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006420_AWAHEEN
669.description: A peaceful accord was reached, and oaths sworn in Vrtra's name. Thus began the dragon's governance of the fledgling state which was to grow into Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006430_THANCRED
670.description: But... If Vrtra is still here, then your position as satrap is just...

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006440_AWAHEEN
671.description: ...A “charade”? Yes, and one which my family has performed faithfully for generations.

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006450_VRITRA
672.description: Many envy the great wyrms their power. Were it known that I ruled here, then the fires of war would burn without end.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006460_VRITRA
673.description: I would not be the flame which consumeth my people. Those few who joined me in laying our country's foundations were, perforce, sworn to secrecy.

675.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006480_VARSHAHN
675.description: 'Tis here. Buried within this semblance of flesh.

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006490_VARSHAHN
676.description: The body before thee is but a simulacrum, constructed by the finest artisans of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han. With mine eye nestled within, it doth serve as an inconspicuous vessel for my will.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006500_ESTINIEN
677.description: Ah. That would explain why I felt the presence of a dragon upon our first meeting.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006510_VARSHAHN
678.description: I am woven with wards fashioned to deceive such arcane senses.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006520_VARSHAHN
679.description: Though 'twas short-lived, it seemeth thy fusion with my brother hath left thee much altered, Estinien Wyrmblood.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006530_VARSHAHN
680.description: From the very first, we sensed the nature of one another. Yet did neither one of us bare his fangs.

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006540_VARSHAHN
681.description: That is all I need know of thee for now.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006550_VRITRA
682.description: With my secret thus revealed, I have for you a proposal. Not as a wyrm of the first brood, but as the ruler of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006560_VRITRA
683.description: With all haste must we take in hand the finished talismans and breach this foul spire. Thence, should it lay within our power, dispel its wicked influence.

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006570_VRITRA
684.description: Yet even with the assurance of the warding scales, the narrow confines of the tower doth limit the size of our force.

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006580_URIANGER
685.description: And thus denied strength in numbers, thou must choose thy soldiers with care.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006590_VRITRA
686.description: Just so. Yet though our Radiant Host is formidable, I see a surer path before me.

687.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006600_VRITRA
687.description: Thou and thy comrades have contended with a multitude of primal beings. Most recently thou didst cast down false gods in Paglth'an and Carteneau, I am told.

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006610_VRITRA
688.description: 'Tis upon that strength I would call. The Scions have proven themselves most capable, and I ask that you serve as the tip of our spear.

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006620_VRITRA
689.description: Talismans would, of course, be provided for each of thy companions.

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006630_VRITRA
690.description: And should you agree to this undertaking, more will be provided to make use of as you see fit.

691.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006640_THANCRED
691.description: There's no denying it's a dangerous proposition, but the rewards may far outweigh the risk. Just think of what we might accomplish if we could equip all our allies with warding scales.

692.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006650_THANCRED
692.description: I worry, however, that even the four of us may be too few for what you have in mind. Might we regroup with our friends first to discuss the matter?

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006660_VRITRA
693.description: 'Tis no trifling task that I have laid before you. Go, steel your hearts and hone your plans─such time as you require shall we spend in crafting your protective charms.

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006670_THANCRED
694.description: It seems a quick trip back to Sharlayan is in order...

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006680_VRITRA
695.description: Wilt thou not lend thine aid?

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006690_ESTINIEN
696.description: Whether your request be made as a great wyrm or the ruler of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han, I see no reason to refuse. Nor will I.

698.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006710_KRILE
698.description: Your time in Thavnair has certainly been eventful.

699.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006720_KRILE
699.description: In my opinion, carrying out Vrtra's request and assaulting the Tower of Zot should be our highest priority.

700.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006730_YSHTOLA
700.description: I agree. While I still have questions concerning the Forum and their grand undertaking, we have all but exhausted our avenues of investigation.

701.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006740_YSHTOLA
701.description: Simply pressing them any harder on the subject will almost certainly result in our expulsion. Therefore I suggest we explore the aetherial sea connection by way of a letter to Master Matoya, then make our way to Thavnair.

702.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006750_ALPHINAUD
702.description: I wonder... Even with the protection these talismans afford us, what can we hope to achieve once inside the tower?

703.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006760_ALPHINAUD
703.description: According to Arenvald and Fordola's report, they were unable to free the Amalj'aa. Worse, their attempts triggered the tower's defenses, which led to a summoning of Lunar Ifrit.

704.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006770_YSHTOLA
704.description: What does it tell us that the spires even have such defenses?

705.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006780_YSHTOLA
705.description: Simply pulling a prisoner from the wall is fatal, thus the direct approach is doomed to failure from the outset. Any further measures to dissuade such actions seem...unnecessary.

706.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006790_YSHTOLA
706.description: Unless, of course, there <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> a way to free the prisoners without killing them. Then it stands to reason that any intruders would be met with overwhelming force.

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006800_URIANGER
707.description: The towers appeared throughout the world in but the twinkling of an eye. 'Twas by magical means these structures were raised, I surmise.

708.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006810_URIANGER
708.description: A spire thus conjured must needs be maintained, and I suspect an arcane catalyst─some manner of “core”─doth lie hidden within.

709.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006820_URIANGER
709.description: Destroy the core, and the tower ceaseth to be...thus liberating the captives without harm!

710.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006830_YSHTOLA
710.description: So we can hope. And I would prefer to enter the tower with a working theory than with no plan at all.

711.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006840_THANCRED
711.description: Assuming Y'shtola's reasoning is correct, the chances of the defenses remaining dormant are small to none.

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006850_THANCRED
712.description: Any primals will have to be dealt with, and defeating one will likely only lead to the summoning of another. Our every victory will only compound the prisoners' suffering.

713.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006860_GRAHATIA
713.description: May we not then divide our forces?

714.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006870_GRAHATIA
714.description: Those proficient in healing will focus on sustaining the captives. That duty can be covered by Urianger, Krile, Y'shtola, and myself.

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006880_GRAHATIA
715.description: The remaining Scions will proceed with the search for the core. Admittedly, this strategy puts both parties at greater risk, but it should bolster our chances of saving the Arkasodara by a considerable margin.

717.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A9_000_001_NONE_VOICE
717.description: Are you sure Alphinaud is in the right group?

718.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
718.description: What of Alisaie? She knows a healing spell or two.

720.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006890_GRAHATIA
720.description: If you're to fight primals, then you'd best have at least one healer with you.

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006900_ALPHINAUD
721.description: And I am more than happy to fulfill that role. I've found wielding a sage's armaments to be rather intuitive, and look forward to testing them against a more challenging foe.

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006910_GRAHATIA
722.description: That she does, but I think Alisaie herself would assert that she's at her best when she's charging unto the breach.

723.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006920_GRAHATIA
723.description: And from what I recall from the Grand Cosmos, there's a spring in her step when she fights by your side.

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006930_ALISAIE
724.description: Ye gods, will you never let me hear the end of that? Rest assured that I will do what is asked of me regardless of who I happen to be standing next to at any given time!

725.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006940_GRAHATIA
725.description: Of course not! As our most talented healer, we need you leading the van, fighting primals on the front lines.

726.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006950_KRILE
726.description: It seems we have a plan; all that remains is to carry it out. I will inform Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han of our movements, so let us make our preparations and regroup near the tower.

727.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006960_THANCRED
727.description: The military post in what's left of the Hamsa Hatchery should serve as a convenient staging point.

728.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006970_KRILE
728.description: That sounds perfect! And remember: the experimental aetheryte at the Confluence is there for those who need it, so there's no excuse for being late!

730.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_006990_GRAHATIA
730.description: We fortified the captives with what magicks we could. Have the defenses been disabled? All appears quiet for the moment...

731.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007000_KRILE
731.description: The lower floors were disturbing enough, but this place feels...wrong. The aether is heavy and thick. Like wading through a quagmire...

732.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007010_URIANGER
732.description: I believe we stand in the tower's beating heart. What sayest thou, Y'shtola...?

733.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007020_YSHTOLA
733.description: I see it. Aether siphoned from the land runs up through the spire, flowing to a single point...

734.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007030_YSHTOLA
734.description: This is the core we seek.

735.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007040_YSHTOLA
735.description: Yet something is...off. As large as this structure is, it siphons far more aether than is required to sustain it.

736.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007050_YSHTOLA
736.description: 'Tis as if the core is feeding on the energy. Consuming it. I need to take a closer look...

737.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007060_YSHTOLA
737.description: ...Curious. There is something there, embedded inside the core.

739.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007080_ESTINIEN
739.description: This is what we came to destroy?

740.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007090_YSHTOLA
740.description: Yes. If you would be so kind?

742.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007110_ALPHINAUD
742.description: And that should be the end of it!

744.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007130_URIANGER
744.description: My theory that the tower might come crashing down following the core's destruction doth appear to be correct.

745.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007140_ALISAIE
745.description: Bully for you! And how are we supposed to survive the fall!?

747.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007160_YSHTOLA
747.description: The floor beneath our very feet dissolves. Brace yourselves!

748.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007170_GRAHATIA
748.description: I pray I'm not too late!

750.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007190_ALPHINAUD
750.description: By my reckoning, we're still on the island where the tower stood but...'tis as if it never existed.

752.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007210_KRILE
752.description: G'raha wove a levitation spell at the last moment. Large enough to catch everyone, it would seem.

753.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007220_THANCRED
753.description: That explains the lack of obvious injuries.

754.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007230_KRILE
754.description: The expenditure of so much aether has taken its toll. He will need plenty of rest, but should otherwise be none the worse for wear.

755.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007240_THANCRED
755.description: Then the immediate problem is what to do with our new friends here.

756.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007250_THANCRED
756.description: They'll be much changed for their time in the tower. Even if their bodies are intact, I doubt we could say the same for their minds.

757.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007260_ALISAIE
757.description: Angelo and I will take care of that.

758.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007270_THANCRED
758.description: I have every faith in you, Alisaie, but there are just too many for you to treat alone.

759.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007280_YSHTOLA
759.description: We'll send at once to Eorzea for more porxies, and call on the local mages to lend a hand.

761.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007300_VARSHAHN
761.description: We were watching the tower, when it simply...disappeared. What happened here?

762.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007310_URIANGER
762.description: The threat is banished, and thy people delivered. They are, however, in need of treatment, and we of a secure locale and helping hands to assist us in its provision.

763.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007320_VARSHAHN
763.description: You shall have all this and more. Come, let us convey these unfortunate souls to the city.

764.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007330_THANCRED
764.description: ...Are we the last to arrive? I hope we've not kept you waiting!

765.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007340_AWAHEEN
765.description: Not at all. Your comrade is feeling better, I trust?

766.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007350_GRAHATIA
766.description: Much better, thank you. Hannish remedies are certainly potent─in more ways than one.

767.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007360_AWAHEEN
767.description: One becomes accustomed to the taste, although I hope you never have cause to do so. Pray take your ease.

768.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007370_GRAHATIA
768.description: Full glad I am to see you all unharmed.

769.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007380_VRITRA
769.description: Valiant Scions. For your heroism, you have my boundless gratitude.

770.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007390_VRITRA
770.description: You cast down that dire tower and set free its hapless captives. You cleansed their souls of its corrupting influence.

771.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007400_VRITRA
771.description: No words of thanks will suffice. In place of platitudes, I offer a bounty of warding scales.

772.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007410_VRITRA
772.description: Pray accept your due reward, along with the goodwill of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han.

773.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007420_AWAHEEN
773.description: Alchemists throughout the land were put to work in the forging of your talismans. The finished ones have been collected, and now await you at the High Crucible of Al-Kimiya.

774.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007430_AWAHEEN
774.description: Present this letter when you are ready to take them into your possession.

775.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007440_ALPHINAUD
775.description: We are humbled by your generosity. Know that the inventive wisdom of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han will be vital in restoring serenity to our star.

776.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007450_ALISAIE
776.description: Every single one of those scales came from you, didn't they? You must still be in such pain...

777.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007460_VRITRA
777.description: 'Tis of no moment. A mere annoyance compared to the dreadful suffering inflicted upon this land and its people.

778.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007470_ALPHINAUD
778.description: Albeit brief, my involvement in the Dragonsong War afforded me a glimpse of the myriad sorrows which consumed both dragon and man.

779.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007480_ALPHINAUD
779.description: Though you were half a world away, such tragedies as befell your kin must have affected you deeply.

780.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007490_ALPHINAUD
780.description: And yet you chose to live among men.

781.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007500_VRITRA
781.description: In the age when that conflict first bloomed, my choice had already been made.

782.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007510_VRITRA
782.description: In some distant place, man slew dragon, and dragon slaughtered man. Yet no hate could I muster for those smiling faces which did look to me for guidance.

783.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007520_VRITRA
783.description: Not even my brother's righteous rage could rally me to his cause. I huddled here, secret and still, hoping against hope that which I had built would remain untouched by the chaos and carnage.

784.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007530_YSHTOLA
784.description: 'Twould seem we share the same desire for peace, great Vrtra. To that end, I wonder if we might trouble you with another question.

785.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007540_YSHTOLA
785.description: The Telophoroi are intent on recreating the Final Days, an apocalyptic event which we know to predate the sundering of the star.

786.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007550_YSHTOLA
786.description: As the longest lived among us, know you aught of this terrible cataclysm?

787.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007560_VRITRA
787.description: Nay. When war and strife drove my sire from his home, he crossed the great expanse with only our unhatched eggs as company.

788.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007570_VRITRA
788.description: He alighted upon a shattered Source, its thirteen reflections long since scattered beyond the rift.

789.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007580_VRITRA
789.description: Of events preceding his arrival, he knoweth naught save that which Hydaelyn hath deigned to disclose.

790.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007590_YSHTOLA
790.description: I see... So again, 'tis the inscrutable Hydaelyn to whom we must look for answers.

791.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007600_VRITRA
791.description: Seek you to divine the will of this star? If so, I have a tale which may afford you some small comfort.

792.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007610_VRITRA
792.description: 'Tis a story from my youth, many, many years ago... To my sire, I once posed the question, “Of all the stars in the sky, why didst thou settle upon this one?”

793.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007620_VRITRA
793.description: To which Midgardsormr did reply, “'Twas the last bastion of hope.”

794.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007630_VRITRA
794.description: He believed, so long as Hydaelyn endured, so too might dragonkind.

795.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007640_VRITRA
795.description: Solemn and portentous were his words. What deeper meaning they held, I could not─dared not─pursue. 'Tis a stone I've left unturned ever since.

796.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007650_VRITRA
796.description: Yet take you solace in the knowledge that, whatsoever Hydaelyn doth strive towards, 'tis an ideal which hath earned my sire's conviction.

797.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007660_YSHTOLA
797.description: Thank you, Vrtra. You've given us warm reassurance in a world gripped by cold uncertainty.

798.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007670_THANCRED
798.description: While I'm sure we all have a great many questions, I think it's time we collect the talismans and be on our way. Our fight against the Telophoroi is far from finished.

799.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007680_KRILE
799.description: We must take our leave, but please do inform us if we can provide any further assistance.

801.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007700_VRITRA
801.description: There is one whom my sire hath judged worthy of honor and respect─the one known to men as Eorzea's champion. This hero of renown and rumor...'tis thee.

803.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A10_000_001_NONE_VOICE
803.description: Midgardsormr and I have crossed paths, yes.

804.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
804.description: I've not spoken with your father in some time...

805.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A10_000_003_NONE_VOICE
805.description: I only wish he could be here with us now...

806.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007710_VRITRA
806.description: I knew it to be so. From man and dragon alike have I learned of thine exploits.

807.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007720_VRITRA
807.description: In accordance with the covenant he forged with Hydaelyn, the stewardship of this star hath ever been his purpose. Silence in the face of thine actions is the greatest sign of his approval.

808.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007730_VRITRA
808.description: I know of his clash with Omega, and the long slumber which was his price.

809.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007740_VRITRA
809.description: Yet even closed in sleep, my father's eyes are far from blind. He is watching over thee; watching over this world.

810.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007750_VRITRA
810.description: 'Twas a revelation most pleasing that thou─a child of man─had gained Midgardsormr's trust. But alongside mine elation runneth a rivulet of dread.

811.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007760_VRITRA
811.description: For upon thy life's reel wind too many threads. Of fate. Power. Weal, enmeshed with woe.

812.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007770_VRITRA
812.description: Amidst this tangled knot, thou shalt know no rest. 'Tis an endless confluence of forces; a struggle without surcease.

813.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007780_VRITRA
813.description: More terrible still is the attrition wrought upon thy companions, as they are swept up in the storm of thine existence.

814.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007790_VRITRA
814.description: Take heart and protect them well. They will be your strength and your salvation. The hope thou wilt need come the end.

815.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007800_VRITRA
815.description: Even cowering behind my curtain, I know the suffering of the powerful. I have watched my siblings driven mad by loss.

816.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007810_VRITRA
816.description: Thus do I exhort thee to spare no effort to keep thy loved ones safe.

817.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007820_ALPHINAUD
817.description: Ah, apologies. We hadn't meant to interrupt.

818.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007830_ALISAIE
818.description: It's just that we <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> have a history of suddenly collapsing, and when you didn't follow us out...

819.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007840_VRITRA
819.description: 'Tis I who must apologize. I have detained your champion overlong with idle chatter.

820.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007850_VRITRA
820.description: Go. At war's end, I pray I welcome thee back into my hall, where together with thy joyful comrades you may toast your triumph.

821.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007860_ALISAIE
821.description: These are the talismans we were promised?

822.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007870_YSHTOLA
822.description: Yes, and I made a quick count: there are far more than we could have hoped for.

823.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007880_YSHTOLA
823.description: Enough to outfit an entire company of soldiers, in fact. Considering the involved process, that they were able to manufacture so many in such a short span of time is nothing short of a miracle.

824.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007890_ALPHINAUD
824.description: Once we have distributed them to our allies in Eorzea and the Far East, we'll have a fighting chance to bring down the other spires─just as we did with the Tower of Zot.

825.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007900_YSHTOLA
825.description: Or, we could use them to invade Garlemald proper, and strike directly at the Telophoroi's base of operations...

826.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007910_YSHTOLA
826.description: Of course, we would need to consult with various Alliance leaders before such a drastic measure could even be contemplated.

827.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007920_YSHTOLA
827.description: To which end I could set out forthwith and present the idea to each of our allies in person.

828.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007930_URIANGER
828.description: Pray allow me to undertake some few of those journeys. I find myself restless, and in need of purposeful duties.

829.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007940_THANCRED
829.description: I can head eastward. Bozja and Dalmasca are just a short hop from here, and Doma's shinobi network should come in handy for passing on the word.

830.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007950_YSHTOLA
830.description: We shall share the burden, then.

831.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007960_YSHTOLA
831.description: Meanwhile, I think it best that you and the others take the talismans back to the Baldesion Annex. We must keep them safe and secure until we've decided upon a course of action.

832.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007970_NIDHANA
832.description: Please, I must speak with you!

834.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_007990_NIDHANA
834.description: Yes. When I spoke with the carer at my bedside, she told me that one of the Scions─a young woman─had cleansed me of the tower's corruption.

835.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008000_NIDHANA
835.description: It seems I've been asleep ever since the treatment... But when I awoke and learned you were all still here, I knew I had to come.

836.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008010_ALISAIE
836.description: As you said, Nidhana was captured only recently.

837.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008020_ALISAIE
837.description: Such a brief exposure is swiftly cured, so I tended to her before we gathered at Meghaduta.

838.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008030_NIDHANA
838.description: And I am truly grateful that you did! I cannot thank you enough...

839.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008040_NIDHANA
839.description: All of you─for everything you've done. Destroying the tower, rescuing our people...you've saved Thavnair from an awful fate!

840.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008050_URIANGER
840.description: Yet who hath truly saved whom?

841.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008060_URIANGER
841.description: Due in no small part to thine inspirational courage, the alchemists were successful in reproducing warding scales of proven efficacy.

842.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008070_URIANGER
842.description: Replications of thy work now stand ready to travel across the seas, unto the hands of those who might wield them against this rising evil.

844.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008090_NIDHANA
844.description: I was so groggy from sleep, I didn't even think to ask.

845.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008100_NIDHANA
845.description: Our great work, sent across the seas...

846.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008110_NIDHANA
846.description: It was worth it. It was all worth it!

847.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008120_KRILE
847.description: Look at that! Its color is completely changed!

849.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008140_NIDHANA
849.description: How unusual. I wonder if the effect is a reaction to akasa.

850.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008150_KRILE
850.description: I'm afraid I'm not familiar with that term.

851.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008160_NIDHANA
851.description: Akasa? It is one of the unseen energies defined by Hannish alchemical theory.

852.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008170_NIDHANA
852.description: Though a gross oversimplification, some describe it as an essence influenced by feelings.

853.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008180_ALPHINAUD
853.description: You imply that it is distinct from aether?

854.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008190_NIDHANA
854.description: Foreign scholars often conflate the two, but we see them as separate concepts.

855.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008200_NIDHANA
855.description: Aether is an energy which permeates the land. It exists within animals, objects, even the air we breathe, affecting all through which it flows.

856.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008210_NIDHANA
856.description: Akasa, on the other hand, exists in a domain beyond our reach. A gift bestowed from on high─or torn from the heavens, in some traditions.

857.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008220_NIDHANA
857.description: Akasa can neither be created, nor destroyed. It is beyond our power to purposefully alter or manipulate.

858.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008230_NIDHANA
858.description: The only thing observed to influence it is an abundance of...I want to say “spiritual emotion.”

859.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008240_NIDHANA
859.description: As a veteran of the battlefield, surely you've experienced moments of desperation or exaltation when you've transcended the usual limits of your capabilities?

860.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008250_NIDHANA
860.description: That is a manifestation of akasa, the invisible essence harnessed by heart, mind, and unyielding spirit!

861.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008260_YSHTOLA
861.description: I really must hear more about this theory! Our disciplines are based entirely upon the idea that aether is the fundamental form of all energy.

862.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008270_NIDHANA
862.description: I'm glad my haphazard explanation has piqued your interest.

863.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008280_NIDHANA
863.description: But even for us, akasa is a somewhat abstract field of study. A lack of practical application lends itself poorly to formalized research.

864.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008290_NIDHANA
864.description: Which is why my analysis of your flower can amount to little more than idle speculation. I am sorry...

865.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008300_KRILE
865.description: Nonsense, you have nothing to be sorry for. Your insight is much appreciated!

866.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008310_ALPHINAUD
866.description: Shall we depart for Sharlayan, then? I will see to it that the talismans arrive at the annex.

867.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008320_THANCRED
867.description: And we will be in touch once our talks are concluded. I suggest you rest while you can─from here onward, sleep is bound to be in short supply.

868.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008330_VRITRA
868.description: Take heart and protect them well.

869.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008340_ALISAIE
869.description: Good, you're here! You haven't eaten yet, have you?

870.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008350_ALISAIE
870.description: We've brought quite a spread if you're interested. Only the finest dining from the Last Stand!

875.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008360_ALPHINAUD
875.description: Lest you wonder, we invited Estinien as well.

876.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008370_ALPHINAUD
876.description: But he refused with a rather grim-faced “No, thank you.” I suspect Sharlayan cuisine is not to his liking...

877.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008380_KRILE
877.description: Oh, I don't know about that. Perhaps our lone wolf just needed some time apart.

878.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008390_ALISAIE
878.description: What, to perfect his brooding stare!?

879.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008400_ALISAIE
879.description: Next time, I'll drag him out by the ear, sit him down in front of a Sharlayan feast, and see that he eats every last bite.

880.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008410_ALPHINAUD
880.description: An excellent idea. Of all people, warriors must take proper meals and rest if they are to maintain a healthy constitution.

881.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008420_KRILE
881.description: Poor Estinien, beset on all sides.

882.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008430_GRAHATIA
882.description: Speaking of one's physical condition, Mistress Krile, I hear you recently played literal host to Hydaelyn Herself...

883.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008440_KRILE
883.description: And what an experience that was. Tiring, yes, but no lasting harm done.

884.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008450_KRILE
884.description: If anything, I should have liked to speak with Her longer... I've not felt a hint of Her presence since.

885.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008460_ALISAIE
885.description: Hydaelyn instructed you to carry that flower, yes?

886.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008470_ALISAIE
886.description: 'Twill be your guide─“test and proof of your conviction.” And then something about seeking joy in darkness, was it?

887.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008480_ALISAIE
887.description: Come to think of it... Isn't that what happened with Nidhana, back in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han?

888.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008490_ALPHINAUD
888.description: The flower did seem to radiate a joyful glow. As if reflecting the elation we all felt. The relief of a people with renewed hope.

889.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008500_GRAHATIA
889.description: Indeed. And in turn, I felt buoyed by that radiance. 'Twas akin to spotting a beacon, and knowing we were on the right path.

890.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008510_GRAHATIA
890.description: I know we've not yet triumphed over the Telophoroi, or learned the full breadth of the Forum's plans...

891.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008520_GRAHATIA
891.description: But even within the midst of our struggles, we find small moments of joy to sustain us.

892.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008530_GRAHATIA
892.description: Rare and hard-won, perhaps. But it is this pursuit of happiness that gives us the strength to carry on, day after day...

894.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008550_ALISAIE
894.description: To the swift, the spoils! Though I recall that levitation spell of yours was quick enough.

895.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008560_GRAHATIA
895.description: Only barely. And even at my best, I'm still too slow to wield it effectively in battle.

896.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008570_GRAHATIA
896.description: Mayhap I simply require more practice with this new magick...

897.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008580_ALPHINAUD
897.description: You unearthed it from the depths of Noumenon, I presume?

898.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008590_GRAHATIA
898.description: Aye, and from a veritable mountain of arcane tomes, at that. 'Twas...necessary to facilitate my solitary explorations.

899.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008600_ALISAIE
899.description: Or, to put it simply, you used it to sneak around the forbidden archives.

902.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008630_GRAHATIA
902.description: The shelves─they're too tall for me! And I could hardly move the library's platforms without attracting attention now, could I!?

907.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A11_000_001_NONE_VOICE
907.description: Are we pushing on until dawn?

908.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
908.description: Shall we call it a night?

909.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_A11_000_003_NONE_VOICE
909.description: You do know these are “my” quarters...?

910.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008670_ALPHINAUD
910.description: I'm not that ambitious. But 'tis pleasant to idle away the hours every once in a while.

911.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008680_ALISAIE
911.description: One last cup of tea, then. Dickon said this brew helps relax the mind before bed...and gave us some leaves for free!

912.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008690_KRILE
912.description: Why else did you think we were here? Surrender to thy fate, O champion!

913.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008700_AMON
913.description: Ah, enjoying the bracing cold, I see. Do you not own a warm coat or a cloak? Something in fur or fashioned from the skins of your enemies, or...? Well, never mind that.

914.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008710_AMON
914.description: I come to you once more as the bearer of bad news.

915.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008720_AMON
915.description: Our tower in Thavnair has been toppled, and I need not tell you by whom.

916.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008730_AMON
916.description: Given how many we have at our disposal, the loss of a single spire is hardly fatal to our plans. It does, however, slow the rate at which we siphon aether.

917.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008740_AMON
917.description: If they continue to preoccupy themselves with the towers, then all will be well. But should our foe prove bold enough to strike at us here, then the timing becomes...questionable.

918.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008750_ZENOS
918.description: Our foe is bold enough. Of that, I can assure you.

919.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008760_AMON
919.description: Yes, very well, then... I suppose I must prepare a proper welcome.

920.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008770_AMON
920.description: Honestly, talk of your nemesis is the only thing you seem to enjoy. Does nothing else spark your interest?

922.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008790_ZENOS
922.description: Equally tedious. Equally disappointing. The world is a tepid bog into which we sink, too weak to thrash as the mud clings to our eyes and fills our throats till we blissfully choke.

923.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008800_ZENOS
923.description: But then came the light. Blinding and pure and hot─so very hot. Enough to set my soul aflame.

924.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008810_ZENOS
924.description: I basked in the afterglow...until the void yawned once more. And then I knew the muck would never claim me again. There was naught for me ahead, so I drew the curtain on all that had come before.

925.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008820_ZENOS
925.description: Burn, burn. Let the whole star burn. I will have my contest. I will reclaim my moment.

926.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008830_AMON
926.description: How wonderful that the emptiness of death has not dissuaded you from committing your life to its pursuit once more.

927.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008840_AMON
927.description: I don't know whether to envy you or pity you...

928.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008850_ZENOS
928.description: You question my disinterest, but what of yours? Despite your noisome antics, I sense you take little pleasure in this endeavor.

929.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008860_AMON
929.description: Mercy, my lord... Such pointed barbs from one who barely acknowledges my existence.

930.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008870_AMON
930.description: Nevertheless, you are mistaken, for I do find this part somewhat enjoyable.

931.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008880_AMON
931.description: You see, when I was mortal, I would always have the same dream.

932.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008890_AMON
932.description: It was a fragmented thing. Disjointed. All the faces incomplete. The setting, too, was unknown to me, so I thought it simply a fantasy of my sleeping mind.

933.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008900_AMON
933.description: Until one day, I realized it was showing me the truth─much as your dream of the Final Days enlightened you.

934.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008910_AMON
934.description: And soon, very soon, the rest of the world will see the truth of my dream too.

935.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06000_008920_AMON
935.description: Yes, I think that is something we can both enjoy.
